description: Search Qumge's Caps — paid services an agent can call, billed per call from the user's Qumge balance. A Cap (short for capability) is one finished job: somebody's API or MCP server with a price list; to you it is a set of operations. Use this when the user wants something done rather than a skill to install: 'make a promo video', 'transcribe this call'. Returns the best few with pricing, measured success rate and latency, and the slug to pass to get_cap. Results label declared direct or uncertain matches; partial_results are separate and never a complete-result replacement. Budget applies to the matched operation reservation ceiling. Publication checks are not proof of real delivery. (Older clients may still call this tool as search_apps — it still works.)

limit.description: How many to return. Default 5, max 10.

max_price_usd.description: Maximum reservation for the matched operation in US dollars, not its unit price. Partial steps are returned separately and never replace a complete result.

query.description: What the user wants done, in their own words. Omit to browse the most-used Caps.

name: search_caps

free_calls.description: Operation name → how many calls each topped-up user gets free.
